description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.  

><notice>  
- If an ID value exists, you must specify this ID; otherwise, the invocation will fail.  
- If the <props="intl"><ph>**Instance Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>  

For more information about instances, see [Instance Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 任务ID。任务的全局唯一标识符。
description.en: The job ID. This is the globally unique identifier of the job.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制

单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为5。
> RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS Limit

The maximum queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account calling this API is 5.  
> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
